terminology.meaning: One ordered slice of the 2026-08-19 execution program, run as a single wrapper OAT project. Wave 4 is the last of them.
One phase of the wave, governed by exactly one immutable external plan.
The immutable source document that is a lane's entire implementation contract.
The category OAT assigns to a piece of work, which decides which model and reasoning effort a Codex route may use.
A test that reads the shipped skill document itself and fails when a rule the wave installed is written back out of it.
